integrity: The general theorem is analytical; independent update-string enumeration provides only finite corroboration. No independent scientific audit or proof assistant certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact recursion and sharp expected-square factor require independent uniform updates and an explicit invariant non-clipping ellipsoid around the unique full-support equilibrium; not asserted for distant clipped states, non-clique graphs, or pathwise exponents.
title: Exact Euclidean mean-square relaxation of random best response on complete networks
